lessonTitle: 67. Symmetry in nature, art and technology
lessonTitleEnglish: Symmetry in nature, art and technology
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Symmetry is everywhere in nature: a butterfly has mirror symmetry, a snowflake six-fold rotational symmetry, crystals have polyhedral shapes.
stages.headlineEnglish: Symmetry is everywhere in nature: a butterfly has mirror symmetry, a snowflake six-fold rotational symmetry, crystals have polyhedral shapes.

stages.headline: In art and architecture symmetry creates harmony: church facades, the Zvartnots cathedral, ornaments.
stages.headlineEnglish: In art and architecture symmetry creates harmony: church facades, the Zvartnots cathedral, ornaments.

stages.headline: In technology wheels, engine parts and aircraft (mirror symmetry) are symmetric; symmetry eases manufacturing and gives balance.
stages.headlineEnglish: In technology wheels, engine parts and aircraft (mirror symmetry) are symmetric; symmetry eases manufacturing and gives balance.
